title: Production-size R6D BP runtime and topology-cache baseline
question: At representative production lattice sizes L=5,7,9,11,13,15, how do factor-graph construction, dense packing, and the fixed R6D recurrence scale before static-topology caching?

scope.observation: deterministic all-zero flux syndrome with all charge outcomes unmeasured; computational microbenchmark only

acceptance: each size has 9L^2 physical edges, 27L^2 binary variables, and a finite dense recurrence
each forced run completes exactly the registered iteration cap
timing separates graph construction, dense packing, and prepacked recurrence
claim_boundary: This is a controlled CPU scaling baseline, not a decoder-accuracy study, GPU benchmark, or a claim about typical observation-distribution latency. It establishes the target sizes and the removable topology-construction cost before caching.
